title: RX-78-2 Atmospheric Re-entry
duplicate_check: No matching host in prior-urls.json, catalog-baseline.json published_games, or previously_seen_urls; confirmed in the prior dedupe pass.
controls_actions: Read the mission brief: manual atmospheric entry, combat with Char's Zakus, shield/attitude and cooling controls, then brake to a safe sink rate for White Base recovery. Started Manual Entry.
Used A during active simulation and selected Shield to Flow; the simulation's elapsed time, speed/altitude, suit thermal readings, enemy ranges, and 3D camera scene updated while the run advanced.

Clicked the visible target lock frame as directed; HUD showed MASTER CAUTION and GUN LOCK. Pressed F; Beam Rifle Energy decreased from 15/15 to 14/15. The mission and kill counters remained incomplete.
gameplay_outcome: A live, controllable 3D atmospheric-entry and combat simulation was verified. The target-lock input and firing input changed the HUD/weapon-energy state. I did not complete the combat or landing objectives and do not claim the Zaku was destroyed by my shot.
mechanics: RX-78-2 piloting/combat and atmospheric-reentry simulation with manual and autopilot modes, attitude, translation and thrust controls, beam rifle and other suit actions, heat/cooling/ablative systems, speed/altitude/ground-track telemetry, and a recovery objective.
visual_art: A detailed 3D RX-78-2 mobile suit with target brackets and scope, a changing space/atmosphere environment, map and telemetry panels, suit-part temperature display, timeline, and in-world communications log.
existing_custom_cover_evidence: The mission-entry overlay contains the game-specific title, briefing, and live 3D suit scene; no separate promotional cover asset was verified.
thumbnail_concepts: Text-free action composition of the RX-78-2 leading with its shield through a vivid orange atmospheric plasma layer, Earth curvature and heat trails filling the background.
Close low-angle 3D mobile-suit shot with a lock bracket on a distant Zaku and an illuminated atmospheric horizon, emphasizing the simultaneous combat and re-entry crisis.
screenshot_note: Manual-entry and active gameplay screenshots were captured and shown inline in the CUA output; this subagent CUA surface exposes no supported local screenshot-file export.
audio: Parent verified the macOS output-mute checkbox is enabled; no native audio settings were changed by this tester. This test tab was closed after the session.
